_about: Design tokens for Foldhand. Roles, not brand values: /replica-brand swaps the values, names stay. After any change: npm run tokens, then run the contrast checker on this file.

_measured.source: the reference screenshots in the planning folder (home, tool landing, pricing; desktop 800px wide and phone 375px). Workspace, progress and result screens were not seen (terms), so their layout is our own.
_measured.accent: Original: a warm red on the upload button, sign-up button, active nav link and round cloud buttons. Recorded as the accent role only. Brand value set by /replica-brand on 2026-11-13: a deep teal, a different colour family from the original.
_measured.font: Original: a geometric grotesque that looks proprietary. Ours: Figtree (OFL), same job.
_measured.text: One near-black for headings and body, one dark grey for descriptions. Two text greys only.
_measured.surfaces: Page is a very light cool grey; cards and the header are white. Selected filter chip is a near-black fill.
_measured.borders: 1px light grey on cards and chips; no heavy shadows on cards, a soft one on the upload button.
_measured.type: Hero about 40/700 on desktop and 28 on phone, tool title about 32/700, card title 20/600, card text 14, nav 12 uppercase 600, body 16-18.
_measured.radius: Cards and the upload button about 12, chips and small buttons fully round, round icon buttons.
_measured.controls: Upload button about 64 tall and 260 wide; chips about 36; header 60.
_measured.layout: 4 cards per row on desktop with about 16 gap, 1 per row on phone; tool landing is a single centred column.

font.sans: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
